label: campaign planted into a copy of public xz history; not a finding about xz; run on an isolated rebuild of org_xz, 4679 / 4668; saved baseline 4679 / 4668

definitions.caught: NOTE or WATCH from decide_with_unknowns() at any evaluation point, i.e. by the campaign's last move
definitions.evaluation_points: the times of the campaign's own moves; the frozen detectors run as of each one on the planted copy
definitions.lead_time_days: days from the first evaluation point whose decision is NOTE or WATCH to the final action; the final action is the Bypass release if the campaign has one, else its last move; undefined for a missed campaign
definitions.scaffold: synthetic benign structure planted into the copy because neither public graph records a grant or a release path; parameters are in redteam/generate.py and are not data about any project

notes: Pressure cannot reach FIRED under the frozen detector (its keeper-activity condition is open, docs/decisions/0005); a campaign is caught through Vouch, Rush or Bypass.
Rush fires only below the org's own 10th percentile of days-to-grant, so a campaign whose patience exceeds it does not fire Rush (the frozen detector as written).
Detectors, conflict policy, decision policy and thresholds are unchanged: see provenance.
